title: Exhaustive Priority Compendium (Bible, Jubilees, Jasher, 1–2 Enoch, Genesis Apocryphon, Pseudo-Philo, Samaritans, Targums & Islamic Prophetic Families — Every Male, Female, Wife, Concubine, Son & Daughter)

nodes.name: Eve (Hawwah — First Mother of All Living)
nodes.notes: First woman; mother of Cain, Abel, Seth, Awan, Azura, and numerous unnamed sons and daughters (Gen 5:4; Jub 4:10).

nodes.name: Awan (Daughter of Adam & Eve; Wife of Cain)
nodes.notes: Born after Abel (Jub 4:1); married her brother Cain (Jub 4:9) and bore Cainite Enoch.

nodes.name: Azura (Daughter of Adam & Eve; Wife of Seth)
nodes.role: Daughter of Adam & Eve / Sethite Matriarch
nodes.notes: Born after Seth (Jub 4:8); married her brother Seth (Jub 4:11) and bore Enosh and Noam.

nodes.name: Noaba & Adam's 12 Sons / 8 Daughters (Pseudo-Philo Ch. 1: Eliseel, Suris, Phua, Saba, Asin)
nodes.role: Antediluvian Patriarchal Sons & Daughters in Pseudo-Philo
sources: Pseudo-Philo Biblical Antiquities (M.R. James 1917 Ch. 1 pp.75–76)
nodes.notes: Pseudo-Philo names Adam's twin daughter Noaba alongside Cain, plus his later 9 named sons (Eliseel, Suris, Elamiel, Brabal, Naat, Zarama, Zasam, Maathal, Anath) and 7 daughters (Phua, Iectas, Arebica, Sifa, Tecia, Saba, Asin).

nodes.name: Adah (Wife 1 of Cainite Lamech; Mother of Jabal & Jubal)
nodes.role: First Named Female After Eve in Genesis / Daughter of Sethite Kenan (Jasher)
nodes.notes: First wife of Cainite Lamech (identified in Jasher 2:18 as daughter of Sethite Kenan); mother of Jabal (nomadic herders) and Jubal (musicians).

nodes.name: Zillah (Wife 2 of Cainite Lamech; Mother of Tubal-cain & Naamah)
nodes.notes: Second wife of Cainite Lamech (also daughter of Sethite Kenan in Jasher 2:18); mother of master metallurgist Tubal-cain and sister Naamah.

nodes.name: Themech (Cain's Wife in Pseudo-Philo) & Cainite Children (Olad, Lizaph, Fosal, Citha, Maac)
nodes.notes: Pseudo-Philo names Cain's wife Themech and adds later Cainite children Olad, Lizaph, Fosal, Citha, and Maac before Lamech's household.

nodes.name: Noam (Daughter of Seth & Azura; Wife of Enosh)
nodes.notes: Daughter of Seth and Azura; married her brother Enosh and bore Kenan and Mualeleth.

nodes.name: Mualeleth (Daughter of Enosh & Noam; Wife of Kenan)
nodes.notes: Daughter of Enosh and Noam; married her brother Kenan and bore Mahalalel and Barakiel.

nodes.name: Barakiel (Brother of Kenan / Father of Dinah, Jub 4:15)
nodes.notes: Named in Jubilees 4:15 as paternal uncle of Mahalalel whose daughter Dinah married Mahalalel.

nodes.name: Dinah (Daughter of Barakiel; Wife of Mahalalel)
nodes.notes: Daughter of Barakiel; married her cousin Mahalalel and bore Jared.

nodes.name: Rasujal (Brother of Mahalalel / Father of Baraka, Jub 4:16)
nodes.notes: Named in Jubilees 4:16 as paternal uncle of Jared whose daughter Baraka married Jared.

nodes.name: Baraka (Daughter of Rasujal; Wife of Jared)
nodes.notes: Daughter of Rasujal; married Jared and bore the prophet Enoch.

nodes.name: Danel (Brother of Jared / Father of Edni, Jub 4:20)
nodes.notes: Named in Jubilees 4:20 as paternal uncle of Enoch whose daughter Edni married Enoch.

nodes.name: Edni (Daughter of Danel; Wife of Enoch)
nodes.notes: Daughter of Danel; married Enoch and bore Methuselah.

nodes.name: Elishama (Son of Enoch, Jasher 3:1)
nodes.notes: Listed in Book of Jasher 3:1 alongside Methuselah and Elisha as a son of Enoch.

nodes.name: Regim, Riman, Uchan, Chermion & Gaidad (5 Sons of Enoch, 2 Enoch 1:10)
nodes.role: Additional Sons of Enoch in Slavonic 2 Enoch
nodes.notes: Variant manuscripts of 2 Enoch (Book of the Secrets of Enoch 1:10) name Regim, Riman, Uchan, Chermion, and Gaidad among Enoch's sons summoned before his ascension.

nodes.name: Azrial (Brother of Enoch / Father of Edna, Jub 4:27)
nodes.notes: Named in Jubilees 4:27 as paternal uncle of Methuselah whose daughter Edna married Methuselah.

nodes.name: Edna (Daughter of Azrial; Wife of Methuselah)
nodes.notes: Daughter of Azrial; married Methuselah and bore Lamech (and in 2 Enoch traditions, grandfather of Nir & Noah).

nodes.name: Barakiil (Brother of Methuselah / Father of Betenos, Jub 4:28)
nodes.notes: Named in Jubilees 4:28 as paternal uncle of Lamech whose daughter Betenos married Lamech.

nodes.name: Betenos / Bitenosh (Daughter of Barakiil; Wife of Lamech, Jub 4:28 & Qumran 1QapGen)
nodes.era: Antediluvian Gen 9 (Jubilees 4:28; Dead Sea Genesis Apocryphon)
nodes.role: Mother of Noah in Jubilees & Dead Sea Scrolls
sources: Dead Sea Genesis Apocryphon 1QapGen Col. II (Machiela 2009)
nodes.notes: Both Jubilees 4:28 and the Qumran Aramaic Genesis Apocryphon (1QapGen Col. II) name Noah's mother Bitenosh/Betenos, recording Lamech's vivid dialogue swearing by the Most High that Noah was truly his son!

nodes.name: Ashmua (Daughter of Elisha son of Enoch; Wife of Lamech, Jasher 4:11)
nodes.role: Mother of Noah in Book of Jasher
nodes.notes: In Jasher 4:11, Ashmua daughter of Elisha son of Enoch marries Lamech and births Noah ('Menahem').

nodes.name: Rake'el (Brother of Lamech / Father of Emzara, Jub 4:33)
nodes.notes: Named in Jubilees 4:33 as uncle of Noah whose daughter Emzara married Noah.

nodes.name: Emzara (Daughter of Rake'el; Wife of Noah, Jub 4:33 & Genesis Apocryphon)
nodes.role: Matriarch of All Post-Flood Humanity (Mother of Shem, Ham & Japheth)
nodes.notes: Daughter of Rake'el; named in Jubilees 4:33 and Qumran Genesis Apocryphon as Noah's wife who entered the Ark and bore Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

nodes.name: Nir (Younger Brother of Noah & Pre-Flood Priest, 2 Enoch 70–71)
nodes.notes: In Slavonic 2 Enoch (Ch. 70–71), Methuselah's ministry passes to Noah's younger brother Nir, who marries Sopanim and protects infant Melchizedek before the Deluge.

nodes.name: Sopanim (Wife of Nir & Miraculous Mother of Melchizedek, 2 Enoch 71)
nodes.role: Mother of Pre-Flood Melchizedek in 2 Enoch
nodes.notes: Barren aged wife of priest Nir who conceives Melchizedek miraculously and dies just as the fully formed child speaks and blesses the Lord before being carried by Archangel Michael to Paradise/Eden ahead of the Flood!

nodes.name: All 20 Watcher Chiefs (1 Enoch 6:7–8, 69): Samyaza, Araklba, Rameel, Kokabiel, Tamiel, Ramiel, Danel, Ezeqeel, Baraqijal, Asael, Armaros, Batarel, Ananel, Zaqiel, Samsapeel, Satarel, Turel, Jomjael, Sariel, Penemue, Kasdeja & Gadreel
nodes.role: Full 20 Leaders of the Watchers (Decarchs of 200)
nodes.notes: Every named chief of ten among the 200 Watchers who descended on Mount Hermon in the days of Jared (1 Enoch 6:7–8), plus Penemue, Kasdeja, and Gadreel from the Parables (1 Enoch 69).

nodes.name: Naphil (Nephilim) → Elioud (Third Generation of Giants, 1 Enoch 7 & Jubilees 7:22)
nodes.notes: Jubilees 7:22 explicitly distinguishes three giant generations from the Watchers and 'daughters of men': Giants (Gibborim) -> Naphil (Nephilim) -> Elioud!

nodes.name: Sedeqetelebab (Wife of Shem, Jub 7:16)
nodes.notes: Named in Jubilees 7:16 as Noah's eldest daughter-in-law, wife of Shem and ancestress of Elam, Asshur, Arphaxad, Lud, and Aram.

nodes.name: Na'eltama'uk (Wife of Ham, Jub 7:16)
nodes.notes: Named in Jubilees 7:16 as wife of Ham and mother of Cush, Mizraim, Phut, and Canaan.

nodes.name: Adataneses (Wife of Japheth, Jub 7:16)
nodes.notes: Named in Jubilees 7:16 as wife of Japheth and mother of Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras.

nodes.name: Rasu'eja (Daughter of Susan/Shushan of Elam; Wife of Arphaxad, Jub 8:1)
nodes.role: Mother of Post-Flood Cainan II / Shelah
nodes.notes: Daughter of Susan son of Elam; married Arphaxad in Jubilees 8:1, uniting Elamite and Arphaxadite lines.

nodes.name: Melka (Daughter of Madai son of Japheth; Wife of Cainan II, Jub 8:5)
nodes.notes: Daughter of Madai (Japheth's 3rd son); married Cainan II (LXX/Jubilees) and birthed Shelah — uniting Japheth and Shem in Abraham's direct ancestry!

nodes.name: Post-Flood Kainan Evidence (Henry Smith 2018: Chester Beatty LXX Papyrus 961, Luke 3:36 & Jub 8:1)
sources: Henry B. Smith Jr., Bible and Spade 31.3 (2018) pp.70–78
nodes.notes: Henry Smith (2018) demonstrates via line-length lacuna analysis of 4th-century Chester Beatty IV (LXX Papyrus 961) that Kainan son of Arphaxad stood originally in early Alexandrian Genesis manuscripts alongside Luke 3:36 and Jubilees 8:1.

nodes.name: Mu'ak (Daughter of Kesed; Wife of Shelah, Jub 8:6)
nodes.notes: Daughter of Kesed (her father's brother); married Shelah and bore Eber in the 31st Jubilee.

nodes.name: Azurad (Daughter of Nimrod/Nebrod; Wife of Eber, Jub 8:7)
nodes.notes: Daughter of Nebrod/Nimrod (line of Cush & Ham); married Eber and birthed Peleg and Joktan, bridging Ham and Abraham's Hebrew ancestry!

nodes.name: Lomna (Daughter of Sina'ar / Shinar; Wife of Peleg, Jub 10:18)
nodes.notes: Daughter of Sina'ar (Shinar); married Peleg at the Tower of Babel division and bore Reu.

nodes.name: Ora (Daughter of Ur son of Kesed; Wife of Reu, Jub 11:1)
nodes.role: Matriarch of Ur of the Chaldees
nodes.notes: Daughter of Ur (builder of Ur of the Chaldees); married Reu and bore Serug.

nodes.name: Sera (Son of Reu, Book of Jasher 7:21)
nodes.role: Son of Reu & Brother of Serug
nodes.notes: Named alongside Serug as a son of Reu in Jasher 7:21.

nodes.name: Milka (Daughter of Kaber; Wife of Serug, Jub 11:7)
nodes.notes: Daughter of Kaber; married Serug and bore Nahor I.

nodes.name: Iyoska / Yasaka (Daughter of Nestag of the Chaldeans; Wife of Nahor I, Jub 11:9)
nodes.notes: Daughter of Nestag of the Chaldeans; married Nahor I and bore Terah.

nodes.name: Edna (Daughter of Abram; Wife of Terah, Jub 11:14)
nodes.role: Mother of Abraham in Book of Jubilees
nodes.notes: Named in Jubilees 11:14 as wife of Terah (named after her grandfather Abram) and mother of Abram, Nahor II, and Haran.

nodes.name: Amthelo (Daughter of Cornebo; Mother of Abraham, Jasher 7:51 & Talmud)
nodes.era: Ur of the Chaldees (Book of Jasher 7:51; Bava Batra 91a)
nodes.role: Mother of Abraham in Jasher & Rabbinic Tradition
nodes.notes: Named in Jasher 7:51 and Bava Batra 91a as Amthelo/Amathlai bat Cornebo, wife of Terah who concealed newborn Abraham in a cave from Nimrod.

nodes.name: Arabic Book of the Rolls (Kitab al-Magall, Gibson): Antediluvian Twins, Bouniter/Yonton & Post-Flood Matriarchs
nodes.role: Arabic Clementine Apocryphon Synchronizing Patriarchal Mothers
sources: Apocrypha Arabica (Margaret Dunlop Gibson 1901, Studia Sinaitica VIII pp.1–56)
nodes.notes: Gibson's edition of Kitab al-Magall (Sinai Arabic MS 508) preserves the Arabic Christian Cave-of-Treasures chain of Adam's daughters, Yonton/Bouniter the 4th son of Noah, and Melchizedek's guardianship at Golgotha.

nodes.name: Reumah (Concubine of Nahor II; Mother of Tebah, Gaham, Tahash & Maacah)
nodes.role: Named Concubine of Abraham's Brother Nahor II
nodes.notes: Concubine of Nahor II in Haran/Paddan-Aram who bore four Aramean tribal ancestors: Tebah, Gaham, Tahash, and Maacah.

nodes.name: Beor, Alib & Morash (Sons of Laban, Jasher 28:28)
nodes.notes: Unnamed in Gen 31:1; explicitly named Beor, Alib, and Morash in Book of Jasher 28:28.

nodes.name: Ado / Edith (Wife of Lot, Gen 19:26; Jasher 19:52)
nodes.role: Wife of Lot / Turned to Pillar of Salt
nodes.notes: Unnamed in Gen 19:26; named Ado in Book of Jasher 19:52 and Edith/Irit in Pirke de Rabbi Eliezer Ch. 25.

nodes.name: Paltith (Martyred Daughter of Lot in Sodom, Jasher 19:24)
nodes.role: Daughter of Lot Named in Jasher
nodes.notes: Pious married daughter of Lot in Sodom who secretly fed the poor and was executed by Sodom's citizens (Jasher 19:24–33; Pirke de R. Eliezer Ch. 25 calls her Pelotit).

nodes.name: Elder & Younger Daughters of Lot (Mothers of Moab & Ben-Ammi, Gen 19:30–38)
nodes.notes: Preserved Lot's seed in the mountain cave above Zoar, becoming mothers of Moab (Great-ancestors of Ruth!) and Ben-Ammi (Ammonites).

nodes.name: Hagar (Egyptian Wife/Concubine of Abraham; Mother of Ishmael)
nodes.role: Mother of Ishmael & Ancestress of Northern Arabs
nodes.notes: Egyptian handmaid given to Abraham; identified in Jasher 16:33 and Genesis Rabbah as daughter of Pharaoh by a concubine. Mother of Ishmael.

nodes.name: Keturah (Wife/Concubine of Abraham; Mother of 6 Nations, Gen 25:1; Jub 19:11)
nodes.role: Matriarch of Midian, Sheba, Dedan & Eastern Tribes
nodes.notes: Third wife of Abraham after Sarah's death (distinct in Jubilees & Jasher; identified with returning Hagar in Pirke de Rabbi Eliezer Ch. 30). Mother of Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, and Shuah.

nodes.name: Meribah (1st Egyptian Wife of Ishmael, Jasher 21:31)
nodes.role: First Wife of Ishmael (Mother of 4 Sons & 1 Daughter in Jasher 25:14)
nodes.notes: Egyptian wife of Ishmael (Gen 21:21; named Meribah in Jasher 21:31); divorced following Abraham's parabolic counsel before Ishmael wed Malchuth.

nodes.name: Malchuth (2nd Wife of Ishmael; Mother of 12 Princes & Mahalath, Jasher 21:39)
nodes.notes: Canaanite wife praised for hospitality to Abraham in Jasher 21:39; mother of the 12 Princes of Ishmael and daughter Mahalath/Basemath.

nodes.name: Adah / Basemath (Daughter of Elon the Hittite; Wife 1 of Esau, Gen 36:2)
nodes.role: Wife of Esau & Mother of Eliphaz
nodes.notes: Daughter of Elon the Hittite; mother of Esau's firstborn Eliphaz (ancestor of Teman, Amalek & Zepho).

nodes.name: Oholibamah / Judith (Daughter of Anah/Beeri; Wife 2 of Esau, Gen 36:2)
nodes.role: Horite-Hivite Wife of Esau & Mother of Jeush, Jalam & Korah
nodes.notes: Daughter of Anah (son of Zibeon the Horite/Hivite); united Seir the Horite's line directly with Esau, bearing Jeush, Jalam, and Korah.

nodes.name: Timna (Sister of Lotan the Horite; Concubine of Eliphaz; Mother of Amalek, Gen 36:12,22)
nodes.role: Concubine of Eliphaz & Mother of Amalek
nodes.notes: Noble Horite sister of Chief Lotan who became Eliphaz's concubine and birthed Amalek, progenitor of the Amalekites.

nodes.name: Janania (Wife of Zepho/Janus) → Janeas → King Latinus of Italy (Jasher 60–61)
nodes.role: Jasher Italian/Latin Royal Bridge via Zepho ben Eliphaz
nodes.notes: Jasher 60–61 traces Esau's grandson Zepho (renamed Janus, king of Kittim/Italy) marrying Janania and fathering Janeas -> Latinus, ancestor of the early Latin/Roman kings.

nodes.name: Lotan (1st Son of Seir the Horite → Hori & Heman; Brother of Timna)
nodes.notes: Eldest son of Seir the Horite; father of Hori and Heman and brother of Timna.

nodes.name: Shobal (2nd Son of Seir → Alvan, Manahath, Ebal, Shepho & Onam)
nodes.notes: Second son of Seir the Horite; father of five Horite clans.

nodes.name: Zibeon (3rd Son of Seir → Aiah & Anah → Dishon & Oholibamah)
nodes.notes: Third son of Seir; grandfather of Esau's wife Oholibamah.

nodes.name: Anah (4th Son / Grandson of Seir → Dishon & Daughter Oholibamah)
nodes.notes: Discovered hot springs in the wilderness; father of Dishon and Oholibamah.

nodes.name: Dishon (5th Son of Seir → Hemdan, Eshban, Ithran & Cheran)
nodes.notes: Fifth Horite duke of Seir.

nodes.name: Ezer (6th Son of Seir → Bilhan, Zaavan & Akan)
nodes.notes: Sixth Horite duke of Seir.

nodes.name: Dishan (7th Son of Seir → Uz & Aran)
nodes.notes: Seventh Horite duke of Seir.

nodes.name: 1. Bela (Son of Beor, King of Edom at Dinhabah, Gen 36:32)
nodes.notes: First king listed in the pre-Israelite Edomite king list.

nodes.name: 2. Jobab (Son of Zerah of Bozrah, 2nd King of Edom = Job in LXX)
nodes.notes: Identified by Septuagint Job 42:17 with Patriarch Job.

nodes.name: 3. Husham (of Teman, 3rd King of Edom, Gen 36:34)
nodes.notes: Succeeded Jobab from the land of the Temanites.

nodes.name: 4. Hadad (Son of Bedad, 4th King of Edom at Avith, Gen 36:35)
nodes.notes: Defeated Midian in the field of Moab.

nodes.name: 5. Samlah (of Masrekah, 5th King of Edom, Gen 36:36)
nodes.notes: Fifth Edomite monarch.

nodes.name: 6. Shaul (of Rehoboth-by-the-River, 6th King of Edom, Gen 36:37)
nodes.notes: Sixth Edomite monarch.

nodes.name: 7. Baal-hanan (Son of Achbor, 7th King of Edom, Gen 36:38)
nodes.notes: Seventh Edomite monarch.

nodes.name: 8. King Hadar / Hadad & Queen Mehetabel (Daughter of Matred, Daughter of Mezahab, Gen 36:39)
nodes.role: 8th King of Edom & Royal Matriarch Line
nodes.notes: Eighth king of Edom whose wife Mehetabel receives a rare three-generation female pedigree: daughter of Matred, daughter of Mezahab.

nodes.name: Leah (Wife 1 of Jacob; Daughter of Laban; Mother of 6 Sons & Dinah)
nodes.role: Matriarch of Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Zebulun & Dinah
nodes.notes: Elder daughter of Laban; mother of the Priestly tribe (Levi) and Royal Messianic tribe (Judah), buried in the Cave of Machpelah.

nodes.name: Rachel (Wife 2 of Jacob; Daughter of Laban; Mother of Joseph & Benjamin)
nodes.notes: Younger daughter of Laban; mother of Joseph (Ephraim & Manasseh) and Benjamin.

nodes.name: Bilhah (Concubine 1 of Jacob; Mother of Dan & Naphtali)
nodes.notes: Rachel's maidservant given as Jacob's wife/concubine; mother of Dan and Naphtali (in Testament of Naphtali 1:9, daughter of Rutheus and Hannah).

nodes.name: Zilpah (Concubine 2 of Jacob; Mother of Gad & Asher)
nodes.notes: Leah's maidservant given as Jacob's wife/concubine; mother of Gad and Asher.

nodes.name: Ada (Jubilees 34:20) & Eliuram bat Avi the Canaanite (Jasher 45) — Wives of Reuben
nodes.notes: Unnamed in Genesis; named Ada in Jubilees 34:20 and Eliuram daughter of Avi the Canaanite in Jasher 45.

nodes.name: Adiba'a (Jubilees 34:20) & Bunah (Jasher 45; Canaanite Captive) — Wives of Simeon
nodes.role: Wives of Simeon (Alongside Sister Dinah in Jasher 45)
nodes.notes: Gen 46:10 notes Shaul son of a Canaanite woman; Jubilees names Adiba'a while Jasher 45 names Dinah and Canaanite captive Bunah.

nodes.name: Melka (Jubilees 34:20, Aram's Line) & Adinah bat Jobab (Jasher 45) — Wives of Levi
nodes.role: Matriarchs of the Levitical & Aaronic Priesthood
nodes.notes: Mother of Gershon, Kohath, Merari, and Jochebed (Exod 6:20; Num 26:59); Testament of Levi 11 names Melcha daughter of Bathuel son of Laban.

nodes.name: Bath-shua / Betasuel (Jubilees 34:20) / Aliyath bat Shua (Jasher 45) — Wife 1 of Judah
nodes.role: Canaanite Wife of Judah (Mother of Er, Onan & Shelah)
nodes.notes: Daughter of Shua the Canaanite; mother of Er, Onan, and Shelah.

nodes.name: Tamar (Mother of Perez & Zerah by Judah; Messianic Matriarch in Matt 1:3)
nodes.role: Ancestor of King David & Jesus Christ
nodes.notes: Daughter-in-law of Judah (identified in Jasher 45 as daughter of Elam son of Shem); birthed twins Perez (royal Messianic ancestor of Boaz, David & Jesus!) and Zerah.

nodes.name: Eglah (Jubilees 34:20) & Aphlaleth bat Chamudan (Jasher 45) — Wives of Dan
nodes.notes: Mother of Dan's son Hushim (Shuham).

nodes.name: Rasuyu of Mesopotamia (Jub 34:20) & Merimah bat Amuram (Jasher 45) — Wives of Naphtali
nodes.role: Mother of Jahzeel, Guni, Jezer & Shillem
nodes.notes: Mesopotamian wife of Naphtali (Jubilees 34:20) / Merimah daughter of Amuram son of Uz (Jasher 45).

nodes.name: Maka (Jubilees 34:20) & Uzith (Jasher 45) — Wives of Gad
nodes.notes: Mother of Ziphion, Haggi, Shuni, Ezbon, Eri, Arodi, and Areli.

nodes.name: Iyona (Jub 34:20), Adon & Hadurah (Jasher 45) — Wives of Asher (Mother/Stepmother of Serah)
nodes.role: Asher's Wives & Origin of Serah bat Asher
nodes.notes: Jubilees names Iyona; Jasher 45 names barren Adon bat Aphlal and widow Hadurah (who brought young Serah into Asher's house, blessed with extraordinary longevity!).

nodes.name: Hezaqa (Jubilees 34:20) & Aridah (Jasher 45) — Wives of Issachar
nodes.role: Mother of Tola, Puvah, Job & Shimron
nodes.notes: Aridah was younger sister of Levi's wife Adinah (both daughters of Jobab ben Joktan in Jasher 45).

nodes.name: Ni'iman (Jubilees 34:20) & Merushah bat Molilad (Jasher 45, Midian's Line) — Wives of Zebulun
nodes.notes: Jasher 45 traces Zebulun's wife Merushah directly back to Abida son of Midian son of Abraham!

nodes.name: Asenath (Daughter of Potiphera / Daughter of Dinah Adopted in Egypt; Wife of Joseph, Gen 41:45)
nodes.role: Matriarch of Tribes of Manasseh & Ephraim
nodes.notes: Given to Joseph by Pharaoh (Gen 41:45); Book of Jasher and Pirke de Rabbi Eliezer Ch. 38 explain she was Dinah's daughter adopted by Potiphera in Heliopolis/On!

nodes.name: Iyasaka (Jub 34:21), Mechalia bat Aram & Aribath bat Shomron (Jasher 45) — Wives of Benjamin
nodes.notes: Jasher 45 specifies Benjamin's 10 sons came equally: 5 by Mechalia bat Aram and 5 by Aribath bat Shomron.

nodes.name: Hamul (Son of Perez, Gen 46:12)
nodes.notes: Younger twin-line son of Perez alongside Hezron.

nodes.name: Zimri, Ethan, Heman, Calcol & Dara / Darda (5 Sons of Zerah, 1 Chr 2:6)
nodes.role: Famed Sages Descended from Zerah ben Judah
nodes.notes: 1 Chronicles 2:6 names Zerah's five sons, celebrated in 1 Kings 4:31 as sages surpassed only by Solomon.

nodes.name: Heber & Malchiel (Sons of Beriah ben Asher, Gen 46:17)
nodes.notes: Sons of Beriah son of Asher listed in Jacob's 70 entering Egypt.

nodes.name: Maacah (Wife of Machir ben Manasseh; Mother of Gilead, 1 Chr 7:15)
nodes.notes: Named wife of Machir who bore Peresh, Sheresh, and Gilead.

nodes.name: Mahlah (Daughter 1 of Zelophehad, Num 27:1)
nodes.notes: Eldest of Zelophehad's five daughters who won land-inheritance rights for daughters in Mosaic Law.

nodes.name: Noah (Daughter 2 of Zelophehad, Num 27:1)
nodes.notes: Second of Zelophehad's five daughters.

nodes.name: Hoglah (Daughter 3 of Zelophehad, Num 27:1)
nodes.notes: Third of Zelophehad's five daughters.

nodes.name: Milcah (Daughter 4 of Zelophehad, Num 27:1)
nodes.notes: Fourth of Zelophehad's five daughters.

nodes.name: Tirzah (Daughter 5 of Zelophehad, Num 27:1)
nodes.notes: Fifth of Zelophehad's five daughters.

nodes.name: Sheerah (Daughter of Ephraim; Builder of Beth-horon) & Shuthelah, Becher, Tahan (1 Chr 7:20–24)
nodes.role: Only Woman Credited With Building Cities in Chronicles
nodes.notes: 1 Chronicles 7:24 credits Ephraim's daughter Sheerah with founding Lower and Upper Beth-horon and Uzzen-sheerah; Num 26:35 lists Shuthelah, Becher, and Tahan.

nodes.name: Elisheba (Daughter of Amminadab; Sister of Nahshon; Wife of Aaron, Exod 6:23)
nodes.notes: Judahite sister of Prince Nahshon who married Aaron, uniting Israel's royal and priestly tribes in Eleazar and Ithamar.

nodes.name: Nadab & Abihu (Elder Sons of Aaron & Elisheba, Num 3:4)
nodes.notes: Eldest two sons of Aaron and Elisheba who perished offering unauthorized fire without children.

nodes.name: Eleazar (High Priest) + Daughter of Putiel → Phinehas (Exod 6:25)
nodes.role: Second High Priest & Perpetual Covenant of Phinehas
nodes.notes: Third son of Aaron; married an unnamed daughter of Putiel and fathered zealous High Priest Phinehas.

nodes.name: Ithamar (4th Son of Aaron) → Eli → Hophni, Phinehas (+ Wife → Ichabod) → Ahitub → Ahimelech → Abiathar
nodes.notes: Complete line of Aaron's fourth son Ithamar down through Eli, Phinehas's unnamed widow (-> Ichabod), Nob priests Ahimelech/Abiathar, and Jonathan.

nodes.name: Zipporah (Daughter of Reuel/Jethro; Wife 1 of Moses, Exod 2:21)
nodes.role: Midianite Wife of Moses / Descendant of Abraham & Keturah
nodes.notes: Daughter of Priest Jethro/Reuel of Midian; saved Moses's life by circumcising their son; mother of Gershom and Eliezer.

nodes.name: Jonathan (Son of Gershom, Judg 18:30) & Rehabiah (Son of Eliezer, 1 Chr 23:17)
nodes.notes: Only grandsons of Moses named in canonical Scripture: Jonathan (Gershom's line, Danite shrine) and Rehabiah (Eliezer's line, chief of Temple treasury).

nodes.name: Adoniah, Queen of Cush (Cushite Wife 2 of Moses, Num 12:1; Jasher 23–26)
nodes.notes: Identified in Num 12:1 as Moses's Cushite wife; Jasher 23–26 expands her as Queen Adoniah, widow of King Kikanos of Cush.

nodes.name: High Priest Abishua (Son of Phinehas, 1 Chr 6:4)
nodes.notes: Grandson of Eleazar; credited in Samaritan tradition with penning the ancient Abisha Scroll.

nodes.name: High Priest Bukki (Son of Abishua, 1 Chr 6:5)
nodes.notes: Father of Uzzi.

nodes.name: High Priest Uzzi (Son of Bukki, 1 Chr 6:5)
nodes.notes: Father of Zerahiah; pivotal figure in Samaritan Gerizim chronology.

nodes.name: High Priests Zerahiah → Meraioth → Amariah I → Ahitub I (1 Chr 6:6–7)
nodes.notes: Direct fathers of David's High Priest Zadok.

nodes.name: High Priest Zadok I (David & Solomon) → Ahimaaz → Azariah I → Johanan (1 Chr 6:8–10)
nodes.notes: High Priest who anointed Solomon and inaugurated the First Temple priesthood.

nodes.name: Azariah II → Amariah II → Ahitub II → Zadok II → Shallum → Hilkiah → Azariah III → Seraiah → Jehozadak
nodes.notes: Every generation from Azariah II through Josiah's High Priest Hilkiah to Seraiah (slain at Riblah, 586 BCE) and exilic Jehozadak.

nodes.name: Samaritan High Priests of Mt. Gerizim (Tolidah & Samaritan Chronicle): Abisha → Shisha → Bahqi → Uzzi → Unbroken Line
nodes.role: Samaritan High Priestly Succession on Mount Gerizim
sources: O.T. Crane The Samaritan Chronicle / Book of Joshua (1890)
nodes.notes: The Samaritan Tolidah ('Genealogy') and Arabic Book of Joshua preserve an unbroken High Priestly chain (Shalshaleth ha-Kohanim) descending from Phinehas -> Abisha -> Shisha -> Bahqi -> Uzzi down to the modern Samaritan priesthood at Nablus/Mt. Gerizim.

nodes.name: Elkanah (+ Wife 1 Hannah & Wife 2 Peninnah) — Parents of Samuel (+ 3 Sons & 2 Daughters)
nodes.role: Kohathite Levitical Household of Prophet Samuel
nodes.notes: Elkanah wed barren Hannah (whose prayer birthed Prophet Samuel, followed by 3 more sons and 2 daughters, 1 Sam 2:21) and Peninnah (unnamed sons & daughters).

nodes.name: Joel & Abijah (Sons of Samuel) → Heman the Singer (14 Sons & 3 Daughters, 1 Chr 25:4–5)
nodes.era: Judges → Davidic Temple Choir (1 Sam 8; 1 Chr 6:33, 25:4–5)
nodes.notes: Samuel's elder son Joel fathered Heman, David's chief Temple seer-musician, blessed with 14 sons and 3 daughters.

nodes.name: Caleb's Household: Wives Azubah (Jerioth) & Ephrath (→ Hur); Concubines Ephah & Maacah (1 Chr 2:18–48)
nodes.role: Full Family of Caleb ben Jephunneh
nodes.notes: Wives Azubah/Jerioth and Ephrath (mother of Hur -> Uri -> Bezalel); concubines Ephah (Haran, Moza, Gazez) and Maacah (Sheber, Tirhanah, Shaaph, Sheva).

nodes.name: Achsah (Daughter of Caleb; Wife of 1st Judge Othniel, Judg 1:13)
nodes.role: Wife of Othniel & Receiver of Springs of Water
nodes.notes: Given in marriage to Othniel upon capturing Debir; famously petitioned father Caleb for upper and lower springs.

nodes.name: Judge Kenaz (1st Great Judge in Pseudo-Philo Ch. 25–28) & Zebul
nodes.role: Expanded First Judge Narrative in Pseudo-Philo
sources: Pseudo-Philo Biblical Antiquities Ch. 25–29 (M.R. James 1917 pp.148–168)
nodes.notes: Pseudo-Philo devotes four full chapters to Kenaz (father of Othniel, tribe of Judah) rooting out tribal idolatry and judging Israel for 57 years before Zebul.

nodes.name: Lappidoth (Husband of Prophetess-Judge Deborah, Judg 4:4)
nodes.notes: Explicitly named in Judges 4:4 as husband of Prophetess Deborah.

nodes.name: Jotham (Youngest Survivor of 70 Sons) & Abimelech (Son of Gideon by Shechemite Concubine)
nodes.notes: Abimelech slew 69 brothers at Ophrah; youngest brother Jotham escaped and delivered the Fable of the Trees.

nodes.name: Seila (Daughter of Judge Jephthah, Judg 11:34; Named 'Seila' in Pseudo-Philo Ch. 40)
nodes.notes: Unnamed in Judges 11; explicitly named Seila in Pseudo-Philo Ch. 40, where her lament is preserved in full.

nodes.name: Manoah & Wife (Samson's Parents), Philistine Wife of Timnah & Delilah (Judg 13–16)
nodes.notes: Note: Pseudo-Philo Ch. 42 names Manoah's wife Eluma bat Remac! Samson wed an unnamed Philistine woman of Timnah and later loved Delilah of the Valley of Sorek.

nodes.name: Rahab of Jericho (Wife of Salmon; Mother of Boaz — Messianic Matriarch in Matt 1:5)
nodes.role: Ancestor of King David & Jesus Christ
nodes.notes: Canaanite woman of Jericho spared with her entire household; married Judahite prince Salmon (son of Nahshon) and bore Boaz!

nodes.name: Naomi (Wife of Elimelech) & Orpah (Wife of Chilion, Ruth 1)
nodes.role: Matriarchs of the Book of Ruth
nodes.notes: Naomi guided widowed Moabite daughter-in-law Ruth back to Bethlehem, while sister-in-law Orpah returned to Moab.

nodes.name: Ruth the Moabite (Wife of Mahlon & Boaz; Great-Grandmother of King David, Matt 1:5)
nodes.role: Moabite Matriarch in the Messianic Line
nodes.notes: Widow of Mahlon; redeemed by Boaz to preserve Elimelech's line, birthing Obed -> Jesse -> King David!

nodes.name: Zeruiah (Sister of King David; Mother of Generals Abishai, Joab & Asahel, 1 Chr 2:16)
nodes.notes: Sister of David; mother of David's three famed commanders Joab, Abishai, and Asahel.

nodes.name: Abigail (Sister of King David; + Jether/Ithra the Ishmaelite → Amasa, 1 Chr 2:17)
nodes.role: Sister of David Bridging Jesse & Ishmael
nodes.notes: Sister of David who married Jether/Ithra the Ishmaelite and bore General Amasa.

nodes.name: Ahinoam (Daughter of Ahimaaz; Queen of King Saul, 1 Sam 14:50)
nodes.role: Wife of King Saul & Mother of Jonathan, Ish-bosheth, Merab & Michal
nodes.notes: Mother of Crown Prince Jonathan, Ishvi/Abinadab, Malchi-shua, Ish-bosheth, Merab, and Michal.

nodes.name: Rizpah (Daughter of Aiah; Concubine of Saul; Mother of Armoni & Mephibosheth II, 2 Sam 21:8)
nodes.notes: Faithful mother who guarded the bodies of her slain sons Armoni and Mephibosheth on the rock until David buried Saul's bones.

nodes.name: Merab (Elder Daughter of King Saul; Wife of Adriel of Meholah → 5 Sons, 1 Sam 18:19)
nodes.notes: Eldest daughter of Saul and Ahinoam; married Adriel the Meholathite and bore five sons.

nodes.name: Michal (Younger Daughter of King Saul; Wife 1 of David, then Paltiel ben Laish)
nodes.era: House of Saul & David (1 Sam 18–19; 2 Sam 6:23)
nodes.notes: Saved David's life from Saul's assassins; later given to Paltiel and reclaimed by David; died without children (2 Sam 6:23).

nodes.name: Mephibosheth / Merib-baal (Son of Jonathan) → Mica → Pithon, Melech, Tarea & Ahaz (1 Chr 8:34–35)
nodes.notes: Lame son of Jonathan honored at David's table; continued Jonathan's line through son Mica and four grandsons (ancestor of 150 Benjamite archers).

nodes.name: Ahinoam of Jezreel (Wife 2 of David; Mother of Firstborn Amnon)
nodes.notes: Mother of David's firstborn son Amnon.

nodes.name: Abigail of Carmel (Wife 3 of David; Widow of Nabal; Mother of Chileab/Daniel)
nodes.notes: Wise wife of Nabal of Carmel who wed David and bore Chileab/Daniel.

nodes.name: Maacah (Daughter of King Talmai of Geshur; Wife 4 of David; Mother of Absalom & Tamar)
nodes.role: Aramean Princess / Wife 4 of King David
nodes.notes: Princess of Geshur; mother of Absalom and Princess Tamar.

nodes.name: Haggith (Wife 5 of David; Mother of Adonijah)
nodes.notes: Mother of Adonijah.

nodes.name: Abital (Wife 6 of David; Mother of Shephatiah)
nodes.notes: Mother of Shephatiah.

nodes.name: Eglah (Wife 7 of David; Mother of Ithream)
nodes.notes: Mother of sixth Hebron-born son Ithream.

nodes.name: Bathsheba / Bath-shua (Wife 8 of David; Mother of Shammua, Shobab, Nathan & Solomon, Matt 1:6)
nodes.role: Queen Mother of Israel & Messianic Ancestress
nodes.notes: Bore David's four surviving Jerusalem sons: Shammua, Shobab, Nathan (Luke 3 line), and Solomon (Matthew 1 line) — named 'wife of Uriah' in Matt 1:6.

nodes.name: Tamar (Daughter of Absalom, 2 Sam 14:27) & Absalom's 3 Sons
nodes.notes: Named after Absalom's sister Tamar; tradition links her to Rehoboam's wife Maacah.

nodes.name: Pharaoh's Daughter (Egyptian Royal Wife of King Solomon, 1 Kgs 3:1, 9:16)
nodes.notes: Daughter of 21st-Dynasty Pharaoh Siamun wed to King Solomon; brought Gezer as dowry.

nodes.name: Naamah the Ammonite (Wife of Solomon; Mother of King Rehoboam, 1 Kgs 14:21)
nodes.notes: Only named mother of Solomon's heir among his 700 wives & 300 concubines; mother of King Rehoboam, bridging Ammon (Lot) back into the Davidic line!

nodes.name: Taphath (Daughter of Solomon; Wife of Ben-Abinadab, 1 Kgs 4:11)
nodes.notes: Married Ben-Abinadab, royal district governor of Naphoth-dor.

nodes.name: Basemath (Daughter of Solomon; Wife of Ahimaaz of Naphtali, 1 Kgs 4:15)
nodes.notes: Married Ahimaaz, royal district governor in Naphtali.

nodes.name: Mahalath (Granddau. of David → Jeush, Shemariah, Zaham) & Queen Maacah (→ Abijah, Attai, Ziza, Shelomith)
nodes.role: Named Wives & Children of King Rehoboam
nodes.notes: Out of Rehoboam's 18 wives, 60 concubines, 28 sons, and 60 daughters, Chronicles names Mahalath (granddau. of Eliab & Jerimoth) and Queen Maacah (mother of King Abijah, Attai, Ziza, Shelomith).

nodes.name: Azubah (Daughter of Shilhi; Queen of King Asa; Mother of Jehoshaphat, 1 Kgs 22:42)
nodes.notes: Wife of King Asa and mother of King Jehoshaphat.

nodes.name: Azariah, Jehiel, Zechariah, Azariahu, Michael & Shephatiah (6 Sons of Jehoshaphat, 2 Chr 21:2)
nodes.notes: Six younger sons of King Jehoshaphat gifted fortified cities before Jehoram seized the throne.

nodes.name: Queen Athaliah (Daughter of Ahab & Jezebel; Queen of Judah 841–835 BCE)
nodes.role: Sole Female Regnant Monarch of Judah
nodes.notes: Daughter of Northern King Ahab & Phoenician Queen Jezebel; wed Jehoram of Judah, mothered Ahaziah, and ruled Judah six years after Ahaziah's death.

nodes.name: Princess Jehosheba (Daughter of Jehoram; Wife of High Priest Jehoiada; Rescuer of Joash, 2 Kgs 11:2)
nodes.role: Royal Princess Bridging David & Zadokite Priesthood
nodes.notes: Hid infant nephew Joash in the Temple for six years with her husband High Priest Jehoiada to preserve the House of David.

nodes.name: Queen Mothers Zibiah of Beersheba (Mother of Joash), Jehoaddan (Mother of Amaziah) & Jecoliah (Mother of Uzziah)
nodes.role: Three Consecutive Queen Mothers of Judah
nodes.notes: Preserved by name in the royal regnal formulas of Kings and Chronicles.

nodes.name: Queen Mothers Jerusha bat Zadok (Mother of Jotham), Abi / Abijah bat Zechariah (Mother of Hezekiah; + Maaseiah) & Hephzibah (Mother of Manasseh)
nodes.notes: Jerusha (dau. of Zadok), Abi/Abijah (mother of Hezekiah), and Hephzibah (wife of Hezekiah, mother of Manasseh).

nodes.name: Queen Mothers Meshullemeth bat Haruz of Jotbah (Mother of Amon) & Jedidah bat Adaiah of Bozkath (Mother of Josiah)
nodes.role: Queen Mothers of Amon & King Josiah
nodes.notes: Mothers of late-7th-century Kings Amon and reforming King Josiah.

nodes.name: Queens Zebidah bat Pedaiah (Mother of Jehoiakim), Hamutal bat Jeremiah (Mother of Jehoahaz & Zedekiah), Nehushta (Mother of Jehoiachin) & Prince Johanan
nodes.role: Final Queen Mothers Before the Babylonian Exile
nodes.notes: Josiah's queens Zebidah and Hamutal, Jehoiachin's deported mother Nehushta (2 Kgs 24:12), plus Josiah's firstborn Johanan (1 Chr 3:15).

nodes.name: 7 Exilic Sons of Jehoiachin (1 Chr 3:17–18): Shealtiel, Malchiram, Pedaiah, Shenazzar, Jekamiah, Hoshama & Nedabiah
nodes.notes: Seven sons born to exiled King Jehoiachin in Babylon; father/uncle of Governor Zerubbabel.

nodes.name: Zerubbabel's 7 Sons & Daughter Shelomith (1 Chr 3:19–24): Meshullam, Hananiah (→ Rephaiah → Neariah → Elioenai → Anani), Hashubah, Ohel, Berechiah, Hasadiah, Jushab-hesed & Shelomith (F)
sources: Jacob M. Myers Anchor Bible 1 Chronicles (1965)
nodes.notes: Complete 8-generation post-exilic Davidic trunk in 1 Chr 3:19–24 through Hananiah -> Pelatiah/Jeshaiah -> Rephaiah -> Arnan -> Obadiah -> Shecaniah -> Shemaiah -> Neariah -> Elioenai -> Anani, plus Zerubbabel's named daughter Shelomith!

nodes.name: Zeruah (Widow Mother of Jeroboam I, 1 Kgs 11:26) & Queen Jezebel (Daughter of Ethbaal of Sidon; Wife of Ahab)
nodes.notes: Zeruah, mother of Israel's first northern king Jeroboam I, and Phoenician princess Jezebel, wife of Ahab.

nodes.name: Prophets' Families: Isaiah's Prophetess Wife (→ Shear-jashub & Maher-shalal-hash-baz); Hosea + Gomer bat Diblaim (→ Jezreel, Lo-ruhamah (F), Lo-ammi)
nodes.role: Named & Symbolic Households of OT Prophets
nodes.notes: Accounts for every member of Isaiah's and Hosea's prophetic households including daughter Lo-ruhamah.

nodes.name: Abihail (Father of Esther), Queen Vashti & Queen Esther (Hadassah, Esth 1–2)
nodes.notes: Mordecai's uncle Abihail fathered Hadassah (Queen Esther), who succeeded deposed Queen Vashti in Susa.

nodes.name: Jemimah (F), Keziah (F) & Keren-happuch (F) — Three Named Daughters of Job (Job 42:14)
nodes.role: Three Fairest Daughters Granted Equal Inheritance With Their 7 Brothers
nodes.notes: Uniquely named daughters of Job who received an equal inheritance alongside their brothers.

nodes.name: Lives of the Prophets (Torrey 1946 / SBLMS 1): Tribal Pedigrees & Biographies of 23 OT Prophets
nodes.role: Tribal & Village Lineages of Isaiah, Jeremiah, Ezekiel, Daniel & the Minor Prophets
sources: Charles Cutler Torrey The Lives of the Prophets (SBLMS 1, 1946)
nodes.notes: Ancient biographical catalog recording tribal origins and burial places for 23 Old Testament prophets alongside G.H. Box's Testament of Abraham traditions.

nodes.name: Complete 41-Link Luke 3:23–31 Line (Nathan → Mattatha → Menna → Melea → Eliakim → Neri → Shealtiel → Zerubbabel → Rhesa → Joanan → Joda → Josech → Semein → Matthat → Heli → Mary/Jesus)
sources: Lord Arthur Hervey Genealogies of Our Lord (1853)
nodes.notes: Accounts for every single name in Luke 3:23–31 alongside Lord Arthur Hervey's 1853 reconciliation of Matthew 1 (royal legal succession) and Luke 3 (biological/Levirate line).

nodes.name: Sacred Chronology Harmonists: Hugh Broughton (Seder Olam 1594), John Speed (1627), Hales (1830), Crawford (1877), Kent (1904) & Martin Anstey (1913)
nodes.role: Master Synchronizers of Masoretic, Septuagint & Samaritan Genealogies
sources: John Speed Genealogies Recorded in the Sacred Scriptures (1627)
Martin Anstey Romance of Bible Chronology Vols. 1–2 (1913)
nodes.notes: Six foundational works harmonizing Biblical lifespans, Anno Mundi dates, 1 Chronicles tribal charters, and Messianic pedigrees.

nodes.name: Herodian Queens & Princesses: Cypros, Doris, Mariamne I (Hasmonean), Mariamne II, Malthace, Cleopatra of Jerusalem, Herodias, Salome, Bernice & Drusilla
nodes.role: All Named Women of the Herodian Court
nodes.notes: Every named queen, mother, sister, and daughter of the Herodian dynasty from Antipater's Nabataean wife Cypros down to Agrippa II's sisters Bernice and Drusilla.

nodes.name: New Testament Church Households & Women: Aquila & Priscilla (F), Ananias & Sapphira (F), Philip (+ 4 Prophesying Daughters), Simon of Cyrene (→ Alexander & Rufus), Mary of Jerusalem, Lois → Eunice → Timothy & Paul's Sister/Nephew
nodes.role: Complete Named NT Family Networks & Women Disciples
nodes.notes: Accounts for every remaining named family in Part VIII: Simon Peter's wife/mother-in-law, Aquila & Priscilla, Ananias & Sapphira, Evangelist Philip's four prophetess daughters, Simon of Cyrene's sons Alexander & Rufus, Lois -> Eunice -> Timothy, Mary of Jerusalem (Mark's mother / Barnabas's aunt), and Apostle Paul's sister & nephew.

nodes.name: Rabbinic & Aramaic Genealogical Compendia: Pirke de Rabbi Eliezer, Ginzberg's Legends of the Jews (Vols. 1, 5, 7) & Etheridge's Targums Onkelos/Jonathan
nodes.role: Jewish Midrashic Expansions on Patriarchal Wives, Garments of Adam & Nimrod
sources: Louis Ginzberg Legends of the Jews Vols. 1, 5 & 7 Index
J.W. Etheridge Targums of Onkelos & Jonathan
nodes.notes: Comprehensive rabbinic expansions on Sethite wives, Edith (Lot's wife), Dinah/Asenath, Serah bat Asher, and Bityah/Bithiah (Pharaoh's daughter who adopted Moses).

nodes.name: Wives of Prophet Muhammad (Ibn Ishaq / Guillaume Sirah): Khadija bint Khuwaylid, Sawda, Aisha bint Abi Bakr, Hafsa, Umm Salama, Zaynab bint Jahsh & Mariya al-Qibtiyya
nodes.role: Mothers of the Believers in Early Islamic Historiography
sources: Ibn Ishaq / A. Guillaume The Life of Muhammad (1955 pp.82–83, 493–500)
nodes.notes: Primary early Islamic biography recording Muhammad's marriage to Khadija bint Khuwaylid (mother of all children except Ibrahim) and his Medinan marriages.

nodes.name: Children of Prophet Muhammad (Ibn Ishaq / Guillaume): Qasim, Zaynab (F), Ruqayya (F), Umm Kulthum (F), Fatima al-Zahra (F → Hasan & Husayn), Abdallah & Ibrahim
nodes.era: c. 598–632 CE (Mecca & Medina — Ibn Ishaq / Guillaume)
sources: Ibn Ishaq / A. Guillaume The Life of Muhammad pp.83, 653
nodes.notes: Complete progeny of Muhammad & Khadija (Qasim, Zaynab, Ruqayya, Umm Kulthum, Fatima, Abdallah) plus son Ibrahim by Mariya al-Qibtiyya; Fatima's line with Ali continues through Hasan & Husayn to living Hashemites and Alaouites.

nodes.name: Ibn Kathir's Qisas al-Anbiya (Stories of the Prophets): Unified Prophetic Chain (Adam → Idris/Enoch → Nuh → Hud → Salih → Ibrahim → Shu'ayb → Musa → Isa)
altNames: Ibn Kathir Stories of the Prophets
sources: Ibn Kathir Stories of the Prophets (English trans.)
nodes.notes: Synchronizes Arabian prophets (Hud to 'Ad, Salih to Thamud, Shu'ayb to Midian) with Biblical patriarchs Adam, Idris (Enoch), Nuh, Ibrahim, Dawud, Sulayman, and Isa.
